description: The items the signed-in person owns, as CSV for an insurance record. Items lent out are included. Wishlist, borrowed and archived items and gifts are left out. Optional filters: min_value, collection_id, location. Columns: name, category, location, collection(s), value, value_source, value_as_of, purchase_date, purchase_price, has_photo. value is the current value when set, otherwise the estimate when there is one, multiplied by quantity, unformatted. It is blank for an item with no value yet: the price paid is only in purchase_price and is never used as a value. value_source is "typed in" for a value the person entered, "Market value, confirmed" for a recent sold-listings value the person accepted, and "estimate" for a sold-listings value they have not accepted. It is blank when there is no current value. Missing data is a blank cell. The result starts with a line giving the item count and total value of the owned items that match, then the CSV. With no filter these totals match get_inventory_summary. An item marked as borrowed from someone is left out of both.

collection_id.description: Limit to one collection, by id

format.description: Output format. Only csv is supported. Defaults to csv

min_value.description: Leave out items whose value (unit value times quantity) is below this amount

name: get_insurance_export
title: Insurance export
